name: AI Meta PM Interview Practice App

mentions.name: AI Meta PM Interview Practice App
mentions.description: This AI-powered app helps candidates prepare for Meta product manager interviews, with a focus on product execution questions. Users practice by speaking or typing their responses, and the app uses AI to score answers against a rubric and track progress over time. It is currently seeking beta testers with early access available.
mentions.problem: Candidates lack structured practice and feedback for Meta product manager interview product execution questions
mentions.audience: Candidates preparing for Meta product manager interviews, with interest from internship-seekers as well
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve created an AI-powered app designed to help candidates prepare for Meta’s product manager interviews, with a focus on product execution questions. The app allows you to practice by speaking or typing your responses, then uses AI to score answers against a rubric and track your progress over time.
